text_block_list.text:
Today was finally the day of the TV drama 
shoot— After taking a break with Yukino 
Bijin, we headed to the filming location.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino, over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City-san! You came to watch!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was free anyway. ...So, how is it? 
Looking doable?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'm gonna make damn sure that 
special training with City-san pays off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm off!!

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text:
"So, does that mean that girl was 
practicing her running here the whole 
time?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes... Even if my legs don't work 
properly due to the injury... I just can't 
bring myself to give up on my regrets."

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text: “...It's not that I gave up.”

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go see her and talk to her one more 
time. ...Thank you."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Looking pretty good! Your voice carries 
well, and your posture is beautiful.

Thanks to all her intensive training, 
Yukino Bijin seems to be putting on a 
solid acting performance.

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Cut!! Great work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san, that was great. Don't you 
think you have a talent for acting in 
addition to racing?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I trained like crazy for this! If 
I'm joining the ranks of actors, I gotta 
be able to act properly, after all!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
I'm real glad to see ya got that much 
professional pride! I'm lookin' forward to 
your future!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Would you be up for acting 
in a drama again? Next time, I want to 
give you a role with way more lines!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, I... I—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become someone who could stand 
on the same stage as those actors, someone 
closer to that strength and beauty they 
possess... That's what I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, it should bring me a huge 
step closer to the 'City Girl' I'm aiming 
to be...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So…… If there's gonna be a next chance—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I felt like I wanted to give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, please let me do it! I'll show you I 
can become an even more wonderful version 
of myself!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, City-san! The photo shoot is 
done~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Yukino. I could hear it from 
over here—looks like you booked your next 
appearance!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!
choice_data_list:
Yukino worked so hard, I've gotta give her 
a reward.

Yukino worked so hard, I'll have to give 
her a reward.

Nothing left to do but keep up the special 
training!

Nothing left to do but keep up the special 
training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Yes!
choice_data_list:

a reward.

her a reward.

Nothing left to do but keep up the special 
training!

training!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Wh-what! Are ya really sure?!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"An afterparty and a celebration for our 
next gig, huh? I'm down. Is there anywhere 
you want to go, Yukino?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... well then, I'd like to go grab one 
of those fancy drinks from the coffee 
shop!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I worked as hard as I could up until 
today, and I was even able to give an 
acting performance the director said was 
spot on—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I really think I was a true 'City Girl' 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So even with a difficult order like that, 
I should be able to get it out without 
stumbling at all...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how dependable. I'm counting on you, 
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me!!

Encouraged by Yukino Bijin's reassuring 
words, the three of them headed off to the 
after-party.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! I gotta become an even better 
actor than I was today by the next shoot!
choice_data_list: I'll support you with everything I've got

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wooww, thank you so much! And I hope 
City-san will whip me into shape even 
harder, too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Things will get tougher than before, okay? 
You might become a future rival of mine, 
after all, so that's the mindset I'll be 
coaching you with.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
R-Rivals!? J-J-Just what I wanted! I'm 
ready for special training right this 
second if that's what it takes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, all fired up. ...Guess I 
can't afford to lose either.

The two headed off together for special 
training— and to support them, I hurriedly 
chased after them.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer!? Don't make fun of meee~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Heh. Feels like the usual Yukino is back.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Though, well, that's not entirely a joke. 
Being able to stoically strive toward your 
ideals is a talent in itself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Unless you're an extraordinary genius, 
you can't reach the top without doing 
that. But on the flip side, as long as you 
keep trying—"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...With you and City-san pushing me 
forward, and after appearing in that 
drama, it really hit home for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just admiring from afar won't get you to 
your dream. But if you gather your courage 
and take a step forward, you'll get that 
much closer to it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll keep moving forward! I'll 
shine brighter and brighter!

As Yukino Bijin spoke, her eyes sparkled 
so brightly that I couldn't help but be 
mesmerized.
